title: The shoulder round places everyone
assumes: The travel is B2's right shoulder round once and a half with number two: it is the call that ends “face N3”, so it is the call that puts everybody on their new place.
quotes: B2  (10) N2 neighbor right shoulder round 1 & 1/2; face N3
notes: The shoulder round is the last call of the time through, so this reading puts the shift where the engine already puts it — at the last call's end rather than at the boundary a beat later. What it changes is the mechanism: a call that carries the progression slides the dancers it leaves out along with their own line (M9g), and the boundary does not.
